title: Introduction To Sociology Ii
modules: Concepts Of Nature Of Complex Organisation…
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are made up of individuals who are dissatisfied with parts or all of an existing type of social organisation."
Social movements are made up of individuals who are dissatisfied with parts or all of an existing type of social organisation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the tendency of bureaucratic organisations to perpetuate them."
Bureaucratic inertia refers to the tendency of bureaucratic organisations to perpetuate them.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a system of beliefs that explains, interprets, and rationalises why a particular kind of political order is best for the society."
Political ideology is a system of beliefs that explains, interprets, and rationalises why a particular kind of political order is best for the society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to such patterns or habits as institution."
Sociologists refer to such patterns or habits as institution.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a category of membership in an organisation whose incumbents are expected to enact a set of roles that are part of the organisational programme."
A position is a category of membership in an organisation whose incumbents are expected to enact a set of roles that are part of the organisational programme.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a formal organisation that takes care of the business of war and defence."
An army is a formal organisation that takes care of the business of war and defence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a formal organisation performing some function in a nation‟s economy."
corporation is a formal organisation performing some function in a nation‟s economy.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the intellectual discipline concerned with developing systematic reliable knowledge about human social relations in general, and about the product of such relationships."
Sociology is the intellectual discipline concerned with developing systematic reliable knowledge about human social relations in general, and about the product of such relationships.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the union of one man with one woman."
Monogamy is the union of one man with one woman.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means „between persons‟ but does not imply that the relation must be close or cordial."
Interpersonal means „between persons‟ but does not imply that the relation must be close or cordial.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a system of beliefs and rituals dealing with the sacred."
Religion is a system of beliefs and rituals dealing with the sacred.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mater of degree, not an all or nothing matter."
Goal specificity is a mater of degree, not an all or nothing matter.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as men (human beings) in interdependence."
A society is defined as men (human beings) in interdependence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the subject matter of sociology and both sociologist and the layperson look at the same reality."
Human interaction is the subject matter of sociology and both sociologist and the layperson look at the same reality.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of acquiring and using power, and government is the ultimate source of legitimate power in society."
Politics is the process of acquiring and using power, and government is the ultimate source of legitimate power in society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an institution that incorporates the institution of government."
The state is an institution that incorporates the institution of government.
fib: ______ are the formal way to spread information through the organisation.
Memos and other written documents
Memos and other written documents are the formal way to spread information through the organisation.
______ is the capacity to think clearly or to act upon a rational analysis of a problem.
additional category
An additional category is the capacity to think clearly or to act upon a rational analysis of a problem.
______ is a persistent social system with a collective identity and a programme of planned activity directed toward the achievement of explicit goals.
organisation
An organisation is a persistent social system with a collective identity and a programme of planned activity directed toward the achievement of explicit goals.
______ refers to a norm so strongly ingrained that even the thought of its violation is grated with revulsion.
taboo
A taboo refers to a norm so strongly ingrained that even the thought of its violation is grated with revulsion.
______ is a formal organisation designed to educate children.
school
A school is a formal organisation designed to educate children.
______ is a procedure, an established ways of doing things, a pattern of behaviour, and a custom.
institution
An institution is a procedure, an established ways of doing things, a pattern of behaviour, and a custom.
______ is a process-situation in which individuals or groups work together to perform a task or to reach a commonly valued goal.
Cooperation
Cooperation is a process-situation in which individuals or groups work together to perform a task or to reach a commonly valued goal.
______ is the focus of the geographer‟s interest.
Territorial man
Territorial man is the focus of the geographer‟s interest.
______ is the social connection between two or more persons, such as friend-friend, leader-follower, or neighbour-neighbour.
interpersonal relation
An interpersonal relation is the social connection between two or more persons, such as friend-friend, leader-follower, or neighbour-neighbour.
______ is the carrying out of the status, its dynamic aspect (what the teacher, banker, senator or plumber does).
role
A role is the carrying out of the status, its dynamic aspect (what the teacher, banker, senator or plumber does).
______ is an assemblage of individuals who possess four outstanding features: (1) heterogeneity, (2) anonymity, (3) poverty of interaction, and (4) looseness of organisation.
mass
A mass is an assemblage of individuals who possess four outstanding features: (1) heterogeneity, (2) anonymity, (3) poverty of interaction, and (4) looseness of organisation.
______ is described as a preoccupation with rules and regulations to the point of thwarting an organisations goal.
Bureaucratic ritualism
Bureaucratic ritualism is described as a preoccupation with rules and regulations to the point of thwarting an organisations goal.
______ is a hierarchical system for coordinating rationally the work of many individuals through a division of labour and a chain of authority.
Bureaucracy
Bureaucracy is a hierarchical system for coordinating rationally the work of many individuals through a division of labour and a chain of authority.
______ is the institution that develops as a consequence of the need to maintain social order in the society.
Government
Government is the institution that develops as a consequence of the need to maintain social order in the society.
______ is an imaginary model, or sociologist‟s conceptualisation, of how social relationships work.
social system
A social system is an imaginary model, or sociologist‟s conceptualisation, of how social relationships work.
